LanguageData.USAC_Civilian01.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years pulling valuable resources out of hostile rimworld ground. [PAWN_pronoun] developed a sharp instinct for finding deposits and a steady hand on heavy excavation gear, and is used to backbreaking work in conditions that would flatten an ordinary colonist.
LanguageData.USAC_Civilian01.title: resource gatherer
LanguageData.USAC_Civilian02.description: [PAWN_nameDef] joined the great colonization effort and ended up on a rimworld. [PAWN_pronoun] is among the most experienced colonists in the colonization force, having lived through more settlement attempts - successful and otherwise - than most people ever hear about.
LanguageData.USAC_Civilian02.title: survival expert
